title: MonitorAlert
description: Output of the scheduled monitor run across all live theses. The highest-leverage artifact in the system: it is the work a human cannot do across thirty positions every quarter.

observed.description: The actual figure that fired the trigger, with fiscal period and source.

recommended_action.description: The monitor recommends; it never changes a thesis status or conviction on its own.

stale_theses.description: Theses whose evidence is older than two reporting cycles.
